items.sum: Tamil Nadu producer bodies, theatre owners and distributors met Cinematography Minister Rajmohan on October 29 to request permission for 6 am movie screenings. Industry representatives want shows to run until 2 am to allow five or six daily screenings and help manage crowded release days. Early morning shows were largely halted after the state tightened rules in 2023 following a fan's death during Ajith's Thunivu release. The meeting also addressed an eight-week gap between theatrical and OTT releases, alongside subsidies for small films. The minister stated that these proposals will be discussed with the government, but 6 am shows are not yet approved.

The Rajinikanth starrer is nearing the Rs 1000 crore club milestone at the box office.
The actress shared her experience working alongside stars like Mohanlal and Hrithik Roshan.
